verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Trello keeping cards two-way synced with a code repository's issue tracker such as GitHub or GitLab issues. The Jira item only describes viewing Jira work in a Trello list, which is one-way and not a repository tracker. The generic Power-Ups, REST API and webhooks are developer building blocks for constructing a sync, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can keep tasks bi-directionally synced with my code repository's issue tracker instead of duplicating data
